programs=work/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_spans = []
    start = 0
    for r in row_divs:
        row_spans.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    row_spans.append((start, h))
    col_spans = []
    start = 0
    for c in col_divs:
        col_spans.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    col_spans.append((start, w))
    # The source tile is the upper-right compartment.
    sr0, sr1 = row_spans[0]
    sc0, sc1 = col_spans[-1]
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            if (ri, ci) == (0, len(col_spans)-1):
                continue
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = tile[(r-r0) % len(tile)][(c-c0) % len(tile[0])]
    return out
'''
